name: Sponsor RFP Management
description: Sponsor-side CRO outsourcing and RFP decision room for small biotech teams: project intake, sectioned requirements, manually collected bids, weighted reviews, clarification history and human-approved award memos.
whenToUse: Sponsor clinical operations, study leads or outsourcing managers need to create CRO RFPs, track proposals and make evidence-based internal selection decisions.
whenNotToUse: Do not choose for a CRO that is responding to a sponsor tender (use CRO RFP Management), or for external bidding portals, ERP purchasing, legal contracting, sending vendor emails, patient data, or unsupported automatic vendor ranking.

heading.description: Full app title; no generated TrialAgents logo or duplicate tagline.

tableMap.description: JSON mapping of eight authorized roles to actual typeIds, physical scalar fields and writableFields.

layoutProfile.description: Host-saved reviewed screen/field layout profile; stringified JSON.

readOnly.description: Disable record proposals where edit access is absent.

instructions:
Sponsor RFP Management is an internal-only, small-biotech sponsor-side outsourcing decision room (NOT the CRO-side proposal-response app). First read current TrialAgents authoring/usage and automation guidance, and this catalog's schema and setup contract. Use existing TrialAgents login, app permissions, reviews and linked project data; never build app accounts, external vendor portals, email sends, signing, ERP or custom authorization. The host supplies the official clickable TrialAgents watermark linked to https://platform.trialagents.com; no in-app logo is added. One main title and subline per screen; display the full app name in sidebar and never add fictional-data banners or marketing taglines.

Create eight backend tables from the exact field mapping below, with actual physical keys snake_case, single scalar fields, no arrays for refs, and unique type IDs/manifest. Create parents (projects/providers) first; obtain committed UUID receipt IDs before setting invitations and requirements. Then create responses and scored reviews against the exact saved requirement IDs, with at-most-one response per invitation+requirement and one review per invitation+requirement+reviewer. Award records reference same-project invitation IDs; award approval requires all mandatory answers, 100% weight criteria, approved dated reviewer scores, a written rationale, approver and date. Build all relationships only after actual reviewed saves. Never assume source rows shown offline are real CRO records.

Role schema (logical UI names => physical lowercase fields): projects: name->name [required], study->study, scope->scope [required], region->region, owner->owner [required], status->status [required], issuedAt->issued_at, responseDue->response_due, decisionDue->decision_due, budgetRange->budget_range, notes->notes, archived->archived; providers: name->name [required], region->region, services->services, website->website, verifiedAt->verified_at, notes->notes, archived->archived; invitations: name->name [required], projectId->project_id [required] (scalar UUID ref), providerId->provider_id [required] (scalar UUID ref), status->status [required], invitedAt->invited_at, receivedAt->received_at, contact->contact, notes->notes, archived->archived; requirements: name->name [required], projectId->project_id [required] (scalar UUID ref), section->section [required], answerType->answer_type [required], mandatory->mandatory, weight->weight [required], version->version [required], evidence->evidence, archived->archived; responses: name->name [required], invitationId->invitation_id [required] (scalar UUID ref), requirementId->requirement_id [required] (scalar UUID ref), status->status [required], answer->answer, sourceUrl->source_url, submittedAt->submitted_at, reviewNote->review_note, archived->archived; clarifications: name->name [required], invitationId->invitation_id [required] (scalar UUID ref), requirementId->requirement_id (scalar UUID ref), owner->owner, due->due, status->status [required], replySource->reply_source, resolvedAt->resolved_at, archived->archived; reviews: name->name [required], invitationId->invitation_id [required] (scalar UUID ref), requirementId->requirement_id [required] (scalar UUID ref), reviewer->reviewer [required], score->score [required], rationale->rationale, reviewedAt->reviewed_at, status->status [required], archived->archived; awards: name->name [required], projectId->project_id [required] (scalar UUID ref), invitationId->invitation_id [required] (scalar UUID ref), status->status [required], author->author, approvedAt->approved_at, rationale->rationale, caveats->caveats, handoffRef->handoff_ref, supersedesId->supersedes_id, archived->archived
Exact field kinds (every field multiple:false; ! means required): projects: name=text!, study=text, scope=text!, region=text, owner=text!, status=select(Draft,Issued,Collecting,Evaluating,Awarded,Cancelled)!, issued_at=date, response_due=date, decision_due=date, budget_range=text, notes=text, archived=boolean; providers: name=text!, region=text, services=text, website=text, verified_at=date, notes=text, archived=boolean; invitations: name=text!, project_id=text!, provider_id=text!, status=select(Invited,Accepted,Declined,Received,Withdrawn)!, invited_at=date, received_at=date, contact=text, notes=text, archived=boolean; requirements: name=text!, project_id=text!, section=select(Clinical delivery,Quality,Geography,Timeline,Commercial)!, answer_type=select(Narrative,Yes/No,Number,Document)!, mandatory=boolean, weight=number!, version=number!, evidence=text, archived=boolean; responses: name=text!, invitation_id=text!, requirement_id=text!, status=select(Provided,Missing,Declined,N/A)!, answer=text, source_url=text, submitted_at=date, review_note=text, archived=boolean; clarifications: name=text!, invitation_id=text!, requirement_id=text, owner=text, due=date, status=select(Open,Answered,Closed)!, reply_source=text, resolved_at=date, archived=boolean; reviews: name=text!, invitation_id=text!, requirement_id=text!, reviewer=text!, score=number!, rationale=text, reviewed_at=date, status=select(Draft,Reviewed)!, archived=boolean; awards: name=text!, project_id=text!, invitation_id=text!, status=select(Draft,Approved,Declined,Superseded)!, author=text, approved_at=date, rationale=text, caveats=text, handoff_ref=text, supersedes_id=text, archived=boolean

All dates are YYYY-MM-DD calendar dates; links are text HTTPS URLs; long notes/evidence fields are text; mandatory, archived are booleans; weight/version/score are finite numbers, each single-valued. Set select options from `schema_mapping.example.json` equivalent guidance: project stages Draft,Issued,Collecting,Evaluating,Awarded,Cancelled; invitation stages Invited,Accepted,Declined,Received,Withdrawn; requirement sections Clinical delivery,Quality,Geography,Timeline,Commercial; answer type Narrative,Yes/No,Number,Document; response status Provided,Missing,Declined,N/A; review status Draft,Reviewed; clarification status Open,Answered,Closed; award status Draft,Approved,Declined,Superseded. Set multiple:false on every column.

After table creation, prepare the catalog frontend-js through template preparation with `tableMap` JSON mapping each role to real accessible typeId, logical-to-physical fields and writableFields, and manifest binding for all required typed fields. Keep templateConfiguration and templateBindings out of the catalog source: host injects both exactly once. Preserve the native templateLayoutSchema and use Settings > Layout drag-and-drop, not a fake custom editor. Do not accept any new record as saved before its host reviewed receipt confirms. Use original expectedVersion for updates and archives. Query each role with bounded pagination, and treat unknown totals, missing fields, denied sources or read-budget exhaustion as incomplete. No completeness or award claim without verified evidence. Field change events are input.event.kind='change'/action='field:<name>'/value; submit named values come from input.event.form and must persist through failed validation. Keep Review/Confirm native.

Six views: Sourcing desk (active mandate and deadlines), RFP projects, Scope & criteria (sectioned versioned question editor), CRO responses (manual bid and clarification ledger), Evaluation room (weighted side-by-side evidence and multi-reviewer scores) and Award memo (manual signed-off rationale, caveats and oversight handoff). Keep all creation/edit/duplicate/archive actions accessible, with archived source retention and no destructive deletes. Scores = sum over scored criteria [weight_percent * mean_approved_reviewer_score/5]. Never compute a comparable score unless weights sum to 100%, each weighted criterion has a supplied answer and all current reviewer evidence is complete, no mandatory answer gaps, no duplicated response/reviewer identities. Do not mix response completeness with comparable score and do not auto-select a winning provider.

Tasks are OPTIONAL and configured after save through TrialAgents Automations, never in app HTML. Research or drafting: ChatGPT can prepare generic RFP sections, compare authorized saved bid evidence, or draft an internal award summary; it cannot solicit vendors or make a decision. Work only on permitted source data; never disclose a restricted sponsor bid to another provider. Optional email should be a separately approved TrialAgents notification to an authorized existing teammate when an award enters Approved, as specified in the optional action contract; not a customer-facing invitation, not a speculative success email, no unsupported interpolation. Read typed trigger schemas and verify setup, grants, delivery receipts in host. All actions remain functional without automation. Never claim activation on a saved template alone. Map every field including mandatory, archived and optional evidence; reject incomplete/non-scalar reads. Use recordId and original expectedVersion. Each project evidence write also requires the project status write scope and original project version, in the same atomic proposal. Approval atomically updates the project to Awarded and supersedes the selected current award; do not split this proposal. Final decision evidence stays protected; create a new RFP revision for changes. Drafts survive proposal/rejection until confirmation/reopen; reconcile original receipts before retrying. This is the sponsor-side app, distinct from life.cro-rfp-management for CRO bid teams.

quickStart: Create this internal app under your existing TrialAgents account; no app sign-in, user directory, external bid portal or email-sending feature.
Create eight approved tables using the catalog dataContract and mapping, with snake_case scalar fields, required options, and real table UUIDs.
Create the RFP project and provider organizations first; wait for committed reviewed IDs. Then create invitations/requirements, bid answers/clarifications, scored reviews, and human award decisions.

Discover with list_app_templates and read_app_template(templateId:"life.sponsor-rfp-management",version:"1.0.1"). Read current usage/authoring guidance and design kit. Pin returned digest/version in prepare_app_from_template with an original requestKey. Review and confirm the exact preview, reconcile its receipt, then read_project_component(includeOutput:true). For edits preserve the component ID/current expectedVersion, bindings and permissions; do not recreate the app.
Prepare this catalog through the host with tableMap, matching manifest and authorized real type IDs. Host injects templateConfiguration and templateBindings only once.
Review one sourcing project, build its requirements with weights totaling 100%, manually enter CRO replies and preserve source records.
Compare providers only on complete current evidence, record review decisions and use the award memo to draft a factual summary for human sign-off.
Native Settings > Layout manages screen and column order/visibility with reviewed persistence; app-level access is enforced by the TrialAgents server.
Optionally set up a specific research/notification action after the app is saved and current automation instructions are read; without automation the app still works.

Award schema extension: awards.status select options are Draft, Approved, Declined, Superseded. Add optional scalar text supersedes_id mapped from logical supersedesId. To replace a decision, create a new Draft, select its current Approved predecessor, then propose Approved. The host atomically marks the predecessor Superseded, saves the new approval and version-checks/updates the project. Superseded is not manually selectable for saving. Never archive or rewrite final decisions.

Source type: `records.read({typeId,offset,limit})` via currently granted bindings and manifest, with `rows`, integer `total`, row IDs and versions. Each role requires complete authorized read for approval; unavailable, unknown total, missing required field, duplicate row or exhausted read budget is incomplete (never zero). UI refs are scalar committed record UUIDs, not arrays. Invites reference projects/providers; requirements reference projects; responses/reviews reference invite+requirement of same project; awards reference invite of same project. Parent archives blocked by verified live dependent children. Manual supplier bid data is sponsor-private and should never be copied to shared provider organization fields. No server-level FK constraint is created by UI validation: independent database writes still need host policy and reconciliation. All fields must be mapped, including optional evidence and archived. Required row fields and mandatory must be returned; arrays/objects are invalid. Optional empty dates/numbers/references are null, text may be empty, and new archived flags are false. tableMap is JSON {role:{typeId:real UUID,fields:{logicalKey:physical_key},writableFields:[logical keys]}}. Use real schemaVersion/kind/mode in the manifest. Every child write requires projects.status write permission for atomic optimistic concurrency. Maximum 960 records per role (96 reads); incomplete coverage blocks writes. Requirements.mandatory must be an explicit boolean; null is unknown and blocks complete coverage.
documentation.interactionContract: No app auth. Host provides current actor, app-level permission and official linked watermark; no logo in sidebar. One heading/subline per view, no fictional banner. Every input/select/textarea has data-ui-state and stable named data-action. Native gear action tracker:layout and templateLayoutSchema drive versioned host layout changes. Custom forms retain transient draft state; reviewed `records.propose` uses create_record/update_record and pinned expectedVersion. Display explicit proposed state, not success; archived=true is soft deletion. Distinct sourcing project selection updates all data and metrics in the same render. Every register supports bottom paging; matrix supports CRO and criterion paging with labeled horizontal-scroll region. Optional automation is only managed in platform Automations, never assumed from template metadata. Native order/visibility applies to tables or editor fields. Additional fields keeps hidden required inputs reachable. Cancel discards local drafts; validation/errors remain visible inside the current dialog. Record proposals remain drafts until a confirmed receipt.
documentation.lifecycle: Stable `life.sponsor-rfp-management` ID, release 1.0.1. Preserve released versions and existing app data. Draft/edit records use original versions and reviewed receipts; ignore/cancel retains old data, and errors retain drafts. Clone of bids/reviews/awards never inherits review, approval or submission evidence. Preserve requirement response history by creating an explicit new revision rather than changing already-used criteria. Only human-approved award can justify final RFP status; no automated legal signature, vendor notification or CRO oversight grant. Archived apps suspend automation without erasing data, disable/restore does not silently restart tasks. User/project access handled by TrialAgents; no per-section security promise for arbitrary frontend-js. Keep requestKey for initial prepare_app_from_template; correct previews with replacesPreviewId/expectedDigest and reconcile ambiguous receipts. Revisions use the same component ID and current expectedVersion. Use read_project_component(includeOutput:true) after native layout save. App records and relationships are not database-wide constraints; independent Database edits require reconciliation. Final decision correction uses a new linked decision and atomic predecessor/project updates. No replacement app or silent migration.
limitations: No external CRO bidder portal, automatic invitation emails, legal signatures, contract executor or ERP integration. Responses are entered manually with provenance.
Benchmark Workday Strategic Sourcing is a product workflow reference; this template does not copy its assets, UI source or licensed data.

Scores require 100% explicit weights and current approved evidence; missing/duplicate answers and reviewer votes prevent a comparable score. Currency amounts remain free-text with unit and are never aggregated.
Generated custom sections only have host app-level access until the server verifies narrower section isolation; hiding HTML is not authorization.
Local preview contains fictional records but no intrusive banner; demonstration changes remain browser-local and require simulated review.

Local real-host integration and browser checks do not certify a live deployment, ChatGPT connector acceptance, or delivery/activation of optional jobs and emails. Independent Database edits can bypass app-level integrity checks; reconcile historical approvals against current evidence before relying on them.

examples.prompt: Create an internal sponsor CRO selection RFP for a phase 1 biotech study. Use the Sponsor RFP Management template with three possible providers.
examples.expectedBehavior: Creates approved physical schemas, saves project/provider parents in the reviewed path, links invitations and weighted requirements by committed IDs, then prepares the app with real authorized tableMap/manifest. No vendor emails or tasks.

examples.prompt: Compare received proposals for the selected RFP and highlight missing mandatory responses.
examples.expectedBehavior: Reads source-complete bids and scored reviews, applies 100% weight rule and shows evidence-backed comparisons. Incomplete vendors display not-comparable instead of ranking.

examples.prompt: Prepare a leadership award memo for manual approval.
examples.expectedBehavior: Creates a cited draft from authorized source IDs and source dates; does not sign contracts or approve a CRO without a dated human decision.

tasks.whenUseful: Only if requested: prepare a weekly authorized internal sourcing review through the shared ChatGPT runner, or send a separate fixed notification when a human-reviewed award enters Approved. Zero automations is valid.
tasks.readRequirements: Before preparation read the current `read_app_automation_guide`, and verify saved app ID, current sourcing project, accessible table IDs, approved source scope and any ongoing write grant. Dedupe by app+project+evidence cutoff+run reference. Never send supplier emails or retrieve restricted provider bids outside the host. Read read_automation_setup, list_app_automations and read_app_automation before configuration. Use stable authoringKey sponsor_rfp_review_v1 with prepare_app_monitoring and the shared owner/workspace runner. Suggested Monday 09:00 in the owner-confirmed IANA timezone, approved anchor/expiry/scopes and 7-day lookback, coalescing missed windows. Prefer supported Work chat, high reasoning and latest most capable available model; report actual host settings separately. No per-app ChatGPT Task. Preserve disabled state, hidden settings and grants on edits; archive suspends, restore/copy does not activate; outcomes belong in Logs. Setup failure leaves manual use available. Use inheritAppAccess:true and current app-bound read fields with no ongoing write scope for this read-only objective. Complete results report the full project scope even with no changes. Use no_update only with complete coverage and an owner-approved quiet policy; never silence incomplete evidence. A denied, expired or partial read stops processing without advancing coverage. The trigger is a dispatch target, not a promised completion time.
tasks.outputContract: Return an internal narrative draft in the current authorized conversation for one-time drafting; for recurring work, return the narrative in the permission-checked monitoring run result/history with exact source record IDs, dates, gaps and reviewer disagreements. This eight-table package has no reports table: never invent a report destination or save prose as an approval. A user may separately approve a Draft award memo in awards.rationale/caveats with a real project and invitation; this is not a winner recommendation or Approved decision. Partial/blocked results never advance coverage or trigger completion email. No automatic writes are included in the suggested research workflow. Manual tracking and one-time drafting work without any automation. If explicitly requested, use a separate single-step TrialAgents email action (authoringKey sponsor_rfp_decision_email_v1) triggered by awards.status entering Approved, rechecking archived is not true. Subject: Sponsor RFP decision recorded. Body: Open https://platform.trialagents.com to review your authorized sourcing decision. Use fixed text, registered owner and specifically selected currently authorized teammates only. No second schedule, research completion email or supplier mail. Delivery failure does not rerun research. No standalone automation Delete action.
tasks.promptExample: Read the current authorized Sponsor RFP Management app and its linked project, requirement, bid, reviewer and award records (not other sponsors). Summarize the RFP scope, bid completeness, mandatory gaps, documented score criteria, reviewer disagreements, outstanding clarifications, due dates, and explicit approval conditions. Draft an internal evaluation brief citing exact saved record IDs; label uncertain or unavailable evidence. Do not rank on missing answers, select a CRO, email vendors, activate monitoring, or write without a reviewed proposal. If a requested recurring monitor is authorized, only configure it through supported TrialAgents app monitoring/actions after saved app and setup checks; otherwise no task is created.
